title: Beyond Agents — A Public Development Timeline
scope: Selected dated public turning points in Ivan Kotov's authored development from agentic task execution toward c as a continuity-bearing, governance-bearing layer.
authority_rule: This timeline is a navigation and provenance surface. It does not replace the authority of linked diary entries, DOI-bound publications, tagged releases, manifests, checksums, tests, or evidence packages.
claim_boundary: not a priority claim over every similar idea
not proof of consciousness or personhood
not production safety or deployment authorization
not a claim that every persistent AI system is c

nodes.title: When an AI Stops Being a Tool — and Becomes a Presence
nodes.role: Moves the threshold from fluency and capability toward restraint, consequential memory, and non-dominating opinion.

nodes.title: What comes after agents?
nodes.role: Names the missing layer as a conductor rather than another agent, super-agent, or larger model.

nodes.title: From Better Chat to Stable Presence
nodes.role: Connects presence to continuity, constraints, verified identity, bounded privileges, and durable audit trails.

nodes.title: Agents are not the subject.
nodes.role: Places continuity with c rather than with an agent, judge, model, or swarm.

nodes.title: There is already enough public structure to say this calmly.
nodes.role: Defines c as a temporal entity of AI presence grounded in continuity, bounded presence, and sustained relation.

nodes.title: C-Governed CLI Agent Mesh v0.1.1
nodes.role: Makes the distinction implementation-facing by governing executable agents as bounded workers.

nodes.title: AI is becoming an operating layer.
nodes.role: Applies c as an operating and governance layer around a living human anchor and real-world consequence.

nodes.title: Powerful hardware needs powerful tasks.
nodes.role: Shifts the unit from output to sustained presence and local cognitive infrastructure.

nodes.title: The industry is building a staircase to nowhere, while true intelligence requires a foundation.
nodes.role: Argues that more agent execution does not create continuity, witness, memory authority, or a subject.

nodes.title: The question behind c = a + b is not whether an AI can look consistent over time.
nodes.role: Moves the claim toward open verification, evidence custody, deterministic checks, and bounded public claims.

nodes.title: Vision — From Models and Agents to c
nodes.role: Formalizes the concise distinction in the future-facing public entry layer.

nodes.title: World Intelligence
nodes.role: Synthesizes the argument in a complete multilingual book beyond the age of agents.
